## Overview

### Why

The homepage's Composable card stacks a Source, FlutedGlass, and Grain. Shaders had no reeded-glass Effect to put in the middle.

### Behavior change

`<FlutedGlass />` is a new Effect. Mount it after a Source inside a `<ShaderScene>`, and it shows that Source through strips of glass. Each flute bends the image beneath it and catches the light along one wall. Mode 2 users get the same math as the `fluteSurface` primitive.

### Checks

- Unit tests for the component and for `fluteSurface`.
- A visual-regression baseline, `fluted-glass-default`, in `apps/docs-tests`.
- Five pixel checks against the stripe probe at `/dev/fluted-glass-probe`.
- A GPU budget run on `/dev/fluted-glass-benchmark`. FlutedGlass over MeshGradient adds 0.04 ms against a 0.2 ms budget.

### Not covered

A UV warp mounted before FlutedGlass, such as Dither, hands the glass a coordinate it already moved. SHA-267 changes how UV warps stack.

## Mount FlutedGlass after a Source

`FlutedGlass` is an Effect. It bends the image that the Sources before it drew, so it goes after them in a `<ShaderScene>`. The component owns the props and their defaults, then hands them to `FlutedGlassShader`.

[](packages/shaders/src/components/fluted-glass/fluted-glass.tsx#L91-L100)

The package index exports the component and its prop types.

[](packages/shaders/src/components/index.ts#L37-L39)

## Shape each flute in one primitive

`fluteSurface` works out how steep the glass is and how far it moves the image, in one call. The light reads the same slope, so it lands where the image bends. The engine [exports the primitive](packages/shaders/src/engine.ts#L70-L74) for Mode 2.

[](packages/shaders/src/primitives/flute-surface/flute-surface.ts#L108-L115)

[](packages/shaders/src/engine.ts#L70-L75)

## Record the default look as a baseline

A visual-regression spec loads the FlutedGlass docs page and compares its canvas with a stored screenshot. CI compares against the Linux baseline, and a run on a Mac compares against the Darwin one.

[](apps/docs-tests/visual/fluted-glass.spec.ts#L6-L10)
